name: motif_add_alternate_form
description:
Author an alternate form. Research first: motif_guide topic conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if one morpheme has a listed form that no regular sound pattern predicts; otherwise use a phonological rule when the project parses with HermitCrab. Forms that share one natural-class environment are already the intended model (guide conditioned-allomorphs). Stages one more stem or affix form on an existing or earlier-staged entry, with its own environments and, when the entry has inflectional grammatical info, inflection classes. Use compose-edit-derivational-affix-restriction for a derivational analysis. It adds no entry, sense or grammatical info and copies no condition from the lexeme form.
Command: compose-author-alternate-form. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

entry.description: Canonical id of an existing entry, or one added earlier in this Draft.

form.description: The alternate form, without affix hyphens.

form_ws.description: Vernacular writing system tag of the form.

morph_type.description: Canonical id of the morph type; stem-like for a stem entry, affix-like for an affix entry.

environments.description: Canonical ids of the phonological environments this form occurs in; omit for any.

inflection_classes.description: Affix entries only: canonical ids of the inflection classes of the stems this form attaches to; omit for no restriction.

after.description: Existing alternate form before the insertion gap.

before.description: Existing alternate form after the insertion gap.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
